title: A Pact Against Gold-Plating the Research Exception?
content:
In the State of the EU address last week, Commission President von der Leyen announced, to some applause, the idea of a ‘Pact against gold-plating’.

This refers to when EU Member States implementing EU laws decide to add extra detail to the features of the official Regulation, Directive or other regulatory tool. While some of this is simple drafting to ensure EU laws fit seamlessly into national statute, sometimes it serves other goals, such as advantaging a given sector of that country’s economy.

The problem is that adding such provisions tends to make regulation more difficult to comply with. It also represents a barrier to cross-border collaboration by undermining harmonisation efforts.

Typically, efforts to address gold plating focus on things like product regulation or reporting requirements. However, the way in which national governments have implemented copyright exceptions – often under pressure from the entertainment sector – arguably provides another strong example.

title: KR21 European e-Books & e-Lending Community of Practice – First Meeting
content:
When?

  • Date: 21 October 2026
  • Time: 11:00-12:30 CEST

    • What?

    Established by the KR21 programme, the Community of Practice provides a space to share experiences, exchange knowledge, and collaborate on practical solutions to the legal, market, and technological challenges affecting e-Books and e-Lending. Read more about the Community.

    The Community builds on the principles set out in Safeguard Access, Empower Europe: An Action Plan to Let Libraries Be Libraries, and supports collective action to remove barriers that prevent libraries from fully delivering their public interest mission in the digital environment.

    Save Your Spot!

    Register now to secure your spot.

    The Webinar

    This first meeting will focus on e-Lending systems. To set the stage, Chair Stephen Wyber will give a high-level overview of where e-Lending in Europe stands today. We will then hear from expert speakers who will share distinct perspectives on the legal framework, e-Book platforms, and the practicalities of managing e-Lending today.
